description: Adds a text comment to an incident. To attach files: either pass URLs already issued via `incident_comment_upload_file`, or pass local file paths in `attached_local_files` and the tool will upload them first. Requires `incident_comments_enabled` on the plan.

file_name.description: Display name of the file as it will appear in the comment.

url.description: Public URL of a previously uploaded attachment (returned by `incident_comment_upload_file` as `file_url`).

attached_local_files.description: Local absolute paths to upload as attachments before posting the comment. Combined with `attached_files`.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

name: incident_comment_create
title: Create incident comment
